{{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Malaysia|Cuisine of Malaysia]]

'''Pattaya fried rice''' (Malay: nasi goreng pattaya), is a Malaysian<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theregister.co.uk/2015/06/20/post_pub_nosh_nasi_goreng_pattaya/|title=Post-pub nosh neckfiller: Nasi goreng pattaya|author=Lester Haines|publisher=The Register|date=20 June 2015|accessdate=19 March 2018}}</ref><ref name="ngp">{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2015/aug/08/omelette-readers-recipe-swap-eve-osullivan|title=Readers' recipe swap: omelette [Malaysian fried rice omelette (nasi goreng pattaya)]|author=Eve O'Sullivan|publisher=The Guardian|date=8 August 2015|accessdate=19 March 2018}}</ref><ref name="origin">{{cite web|url=https://kumparan.com/@kumparanfood/selain-indonesia-7-negara-ini-juga-punya-nasi-goreng-yang-nikmat|title=Selain Indonesia, 7 Negara Ini Juga Punya 'Nasi Goreng' yang Nikmat|language=Indonesian|publisher=Kumparan|date=10 January 2018|accessdate=19 March 2018}}</ref> dish made by wrapping [[Cookbook:Chicken fried rice|chicken fried rice]] in an [[Cookbook:Omelette|omelette]] pouch.<ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.mykitchensnippets.com/2008/07/nasi-goreng-pattaya-pattaya-fried-rice.html | title = Pattaya Fried Rice | access-date = 28 June 2009 | format = HTML | language = English }}</ref> It is similar to the [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Japan|Japanese]] ''[[w:Omurice|omurice]]''.

==Ingredients==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] (2 tbsp for frying and 1 tbsp for making an omelette)
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 red [[Cookbook:Chilli|chillies]], cut in {{convert|1|cm|in}} [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] finely
* 2 [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] fillets, cut in {{convert|1.5|cm|in}} pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 8.8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) green [[Cookbook:Peas|peas]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], diced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallion]], cut in {{convert|1|cm|in}} dice
* 2 cups (300 g / 11 oz) cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]
* 2 tbsp ''[[Cookbook:Fish Sauce|nam pla]]'' (fish sauce) 
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1½ tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Jalapeno|jalapeno]], minced
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] for making omelette

==Procedure==

# Heat the oil in a [[Cookbook:Non-stick|non-stick]] pan. When the oil is hot, [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the garlic and shallots, stirring until brown and fragrant.
# Add the chicken pieces, carrot, green peas, and red chilli. Stir for 2 minutes.
# Add the rice, ''nam pla'', tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until all mixed.
# To make the omelette, heat the oil in a separate pan. Beat the eggs, and pour into the pan. Cook until the egg is browned on the bottom.
# Flip the egg over to cook on the other side.
# Place a ball of the fried rice mixture in the center of the omelette. Fold up the 4 edges of the omelette to enclose the rice. Flip it onto a serving plate.
# Serve hot.
